column2: I opened a checking account with Bank of America in XX/XX/XXXX and made direct deposit totaled {$4000.00} by end of XXXX to qualify for the sign up bonus. The advertised terms state that the bonus would be posted within 60 days after fulfilling the requirement, but it hasn't posted as of today. I first called BoA customer service on XX/XX/XXXX and the representative ensured that I qualified for the bonus and put in an escalation for me. She said the investigation would take 7-10 business days. I called again on XXXX and the representative said there was no update and I should check my account in a week for the bonus and call back if nothing. As of today XX/XX/XXXX, there is still nothing, and I doubt calling BoA customer service for the 3rd time will lead to any progress at this point.

USCB America is reporting a debt on my credit file that I do not owe. I recently checked my credit and noticed this debt, I called and paid it immediately. I was very confused about this debt because I had no idea it even existed. I never received any calls, notices, or letters about this debt which violates my 30 day right to dispute. Not only did they fail to notify me for one of the debts but TWO. How does this happen? After paying and giving them some time to update I check my credit again to find that the debt is still being reported. This is ridiculous!!! I don't understand how this company can add these items to my credit without notifying me and continue to report debt when I have paid them. This is erroneous and ridiculous. I need this removed from my credit file IMMEDIATLY.

Wayfair closed my account without even notifying me and it made my credit score drop!!! The creditors are intentionally trying to keep me in subprime loans at high uncapped interest rates and have been for thirty years!! I work for the government! I know my balance is high but I pay my payments timely!! They are just mad because I have deferred interest and they are not making a huge profit off me as I am not paying off the balance and purchasing more and more! I only buy what I must to get by as a twice widowed mother that is all I can afford! I already disputed with XXXX and they did nothing less than a week letter sent me notice it was accurate!! Shut these crooks down they are working together to ruin everyones credit so that they have to pay unregulated usury interest rates!!!
